  4. 04 Customers <div>
    Customers 
    <div class="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 class="page-header__title">Customers</h1>
          <p class="text-muted">40 customers across 12 countries</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn" data-toast="Invitation link copied. Share it with your new customer." data-toast-variant="success"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> Invite customer</button>

  5. 05 Section 2 <div>
    Card Charts
    Section 2 
    <div class="dashboard-grid">
        <div class="card card--flat">
          <div class="card__body">
            <figure class="chart" data-viz="donut" data-source="sales" data-path="segments" data-x="segment" data-series="customers:Customers" data-format="integer">
              <figcaption class="chart__caption">
                <span class="chart__title">Customers by segment</span>
                <span class="chart__subtitle">All customers</span>
              </figcaption>
              <p class="chart__fallback">18 active, 8 new, 6 at risk, 5 VIP and 3 churned customers.</p>
            </figure>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card card--flat">
          <div class="card__body">
            <figure class="chart" data-viz="hbar" data-source="sales" data-path="segments" data-x="segment" data-series="spent:Spend:1" data-format="currency-compact">
              <figcaption class="chart__caption">
                <span class="chart__title">Lifetime spend by segment</span>
                <span class="chart__subtitle">All time, USD</span>
              </figcaption>
              <p class="chart__fallback">Active customers have spent $16,031 in total; VIP customers $15,235.</p>
            </figure>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
  6. 06 All customers <section>
    Pagination Card Data grid
    All customers 
    <section class="card card--flat" aria-labelledby="customers-grid-title">
        <div class="card__body">
          <h2 class="card__title" id="customers-grid-title">All customers</h2>
          <div class="data-grid" data-grid data-source="customers" data-page-size="8" data-label="customers">
            <form class="data-grid__toolbar" action="customers.html" method="get">
              <div class="field">
                <label class="field__label" for="customers-search">Search</label>
                <input class="input" id="customers-search" name="q" type="search" placeholder="Name, email, country…" autocomplete="off" data-grid-search>
              </div>
              <div class="field field--narrow">
                <label class="field__label" for="customers-segment">Segment</label>
                <select class="select" id="customers-segment" name="segment" data-grid-filter="segment">
                  <option value="">All segments</option>
                  <option>VIP</option>
                  <option>Active</option>
                  <option>New</option>
                  <option>At risk</option>
                  <option>Churned</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary" data-grid-export hidden><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4M7 10l5 5 5-5M12 15V3"/></svg> Export CSV</button>
            </form>
            <div class="table-wrapper" role="region" aria-labelledby="customers-caption" tabindex="0">
              <table class="table">
                <caption id="customers-caption" class="visually-hidden">Customers</caption>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col" data-key="name" data-sort="text" data-render="person">Customer</th>
                    <th scope="col" data-key="segment" data-sort="text" data-render="badge">Segment</th>
                    <th scope="col" data-key="country" data-sort="text">Country</th>
                    <th scope="col" data-key="orders" data-sort="number" class="num">Orders</th>
                    <th scope="col" data-key="spent" data-sort="number" data-format="currency" class="num">Lifetime spend</th>
                    <th scope="col" data-key="lastOrder" data-sort="date" data-format="date">Last order</th>
                    <th scope="col" data-render="action" data-action="message" data-action-label="Message"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                <tr><td>Olivia Chen</td><td><span class="badge badge--primary">VIP</span></td><td>India</td><td class="num">38</td><td class="num">$3,332.80</td><td>5 Sep 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Noah Williams</td><td><span class="badge badge--success">Active</span></td><td>Japan</td><td class="num">4</td><td class="num">$475.30</td><td>20 Sep 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Sofia García</td><td><span class="badge badge--success">Active</span></td><td>Spain</td><td class="num">11</td><td class="num">$1,513.72</td><td>2 Oct 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Liam Okafor</td><td><span class="badge badge--primary">New</span></td><td>Australia</td><td class="num">1</td><td class="num">$119.81</td><td>8 Oct 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Emma Svensson</td><td><span class="badge badge--primary">VIP</span></td><td>United Kingdom</td><td class="num">28</td><td class="num">$3,631.36</td><td>5 Oct 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Mateo Ortiz</td><td><span class="badge badge--primary">New</span></td><td>Spain</td><td class="num">1</td><td class="num">$124.36</td><td>8 Oct 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Amara Kone</td><td><span class="badge badge--warning">At risk</span></td><td>Kenya</td><td class="num">5</td><td class="num">$645.78</td><td>26 Jun 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Priya Raman</td><td><span class="badge badge--warning">At risk</span></td><td>United Kingdom</td><td class="num">6</td><td class="num">$553.43</td><td>23 Jul 2026</td><td></td></tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <div class="data-grid__footer">
              <p data-grid-status>Showing 8 of 40 customers</p>
              <nav class="pagination" aria-label="Customer pages" data-grid-pagination></nav>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
  7. 07 Theme panel Shared partial
    src/layouts/partials/theme-panel.html
    Theme panel 
    <dialog class="dialog drawer" id="theme-panel" aria-labelledby="theme-panel-title" closedby="any">
  <div class="dialog__header">
    <h2 class="dialog__title" id="theme-panel-title">Customize theme</h2>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" commandfor="theme-panel" command="close">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
      <span class="visually-hidden">Close theme panel</span>
    </button>
  </div>
  <form class="dialog__body form" data-theme-customizer>
    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Mode</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="system"><span class="segmented__label">System</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="light"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg> Light</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="dark"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg> Dark</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Brand colour</legend>
      <div class="swatches">
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="indigo"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--indigo"></span> Indigo</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="teal"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--teal"></span> Teal</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="violet"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--violet"></span> Violet</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="rose"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--rose"></span> Rose</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="amber"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--amber"></span> Amber</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="slate"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--slate"></span> Slate</label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-custom-color">Or pick any brand colour</label>
      <p class="field__hint" id="theme-custom-hint">Shades are adjusted automatically to keep text readable in both themes.</p>
      <input class="color-input" id="theme-custom-color" name="custom" type="color" value="#2a4fcf" aria-describedby="theme-custom-hint">
    </div>

    <p class="text-sm text-muted" role="status" data-theme-contrast></p>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Density</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="compact"><span class="segmented__label">Compact</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="comfortable"><span class="segmented__label">Comfortable</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Corners</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="sharp"><span class="segmented__label">Sharp</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="round"><span class="segmented__label">Round</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-css-output">CSS for your project</label>
      <textarea class="textarea textarea--code" id="theme-css-output" readonly rows="8" data-theme-output></textarea>
    </div>

    <div class="form-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm" data-copy data-copy-target="#theme-css-output" hidden><span data-copy-label>Copy CSS</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm btn--ghost" data-theme-reset>Reset to defaults</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
